Klasse BiOutputMapping<I1,I2,O>

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.automata.BiOutputMapping<I1,I2,O>
Typparameter:
I1 - the first input type (e.g., state)
I2 - the second input type (e.g., input symbol)
O - the output type (e.g., output symbol or next state)
public class BiOutputMapping<I1,I2,O> extends Object

Represents a two-input declarative output mapping for state machines (such as Mealy machines or transitions).

Provides a fluent DSL entry point via from(Object, Object) to construct mappings of the form from(state, input).goTo(output) and combine them into a functional mapping via biCombine(BiOutputMapping[]).

      @SafeVarargs public static <I1,I2,O> org.quurz.foomp.base.core.Fun2<I1,I2,O> biCombine(@NonNull BiOutputMapping<I1,I2,O>... mappings)

      Combines multiple BiOutputMapping instances into a single Fun2 two-argument functional mapping.

      Typparameter:
      I1 - the first input type
      I2 - the second input type
      O - the output type
      Parameter:
      mappings - the mappings to combine; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      a function mapping pairs of inputs to outputs based on the provided mappings
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if mappings is null or contains null elements
      IllegalStateException - if duplicate input pairs are provided
